title: Modern Family Home in Riverside
description: A beautifully renovated four-bedroom family home nestled in the heart of Riverside's most sought-after neighbourhood. The open-plan kitchen and living area flow seamlessly onto a large entertainer's deck overlooking a lush, landscaped garden. Premium finishes throughout include stone benchtops, engineered hardwood floors, and a state-of-the-art home theatre. Walking distance to top-rated schools, parks, and the vibrant village high street.

title: Downtown Luxury Penthouse
description: An exceptional penthouse apartment occupying the entire top floor of the iconic Meridian Tower. Floor-to-ceiling windows provide breathtaking 360-degree city views. The designer kitchen features Sub-Zero appliances and a waterfall island. Two private terraces are perfect for al-fresco dining. Concierge service, rooftop pool, and a dedicated parking bay are all included. A rare opportunity to live above it all.

title: Coastal Villa with Ocean Views
description: An architectural masterpiece perched on the cliffs above Malibu Beach. This five-bedroom oceanfront villa was designed by award-winning architect Samuel Reid and features an infinity pool that appears to merge with the Pacific Ocean. The great room boasts 22-foot ceilings and floor-to-ceiling glass walls. The chef's kitchen, wine cellar, and private beach access complete this extraordinary offering. A true trophy property.

title: Charming Craftsman Bungalow
description: A lovingly restored 1920s Craftsman bungalow that seamlessly blends period character with modern comfort. Original features including exposed beams, hardwood floors, and a classic front porch have been carefully preserved. The updated kitchen opens to a private courtyard garden. Located on a quiet, tree-lined street just two blocks from the local farmers' market and independent cafes. Move-in ready.

title: Contemporary Studio in Arts District
description: A sleek, light-filled studio apartment in the heart of Denver's vibrant Arts District. Polished concrete floors, exposed brick, and 12-foot ceilings give this space an industrial-chic character. The fully equipped kitchen and clever storage solutions make the most of every square foot. Steps from galleries, restaurants, and light rail. Ideal for young professionals or as a pied-à-terre.

title: Beachfront Condo with Private Terrace
description: Wake up to the sound of the ocean in this stunning two-bedroom beachfront condo. The open-plan living space is flooded with natural light and opens directly onto a large private terrace with unobstructed sea views. The building offers resort-style amenities including a heated pool, spa, and gym. Just steps from the beach, waterfront dining, and boutique shopping.
address: 200 Ocean Drive, Unit 8A, Miami Beach, FL 33139

title: Executive Home on Golf Course
description: An impressive executive residence on the 12th fairway of the prestigious Oakwood Golf Club. This six-bedroom home was built for entertaining with a grand formal dining room, billiards room, and a resort-style outdoor entertaining area. The master suite occupies the entire east wing and features a spa-inspired ensuite and walk-in wardrobe. Three-car garage, full home automation, and 24-hour gated community.

title: Urban Loft in Financial District
description: A sophisticated loft conversion in a heritage-listed former bank building in the Financial District. Soaring ceilings with original ornate plasterwork, polished marble floors, and a mezzanine sleeping area create a truly one-of-a-kind living space. The fully equipped gourmet kitchen and generous living areas make this ideal for professionals who value character. Building amenities include a rooftop garden and private cinema.

title: Townhouse with Private Rooftop
description: A newly built three-level townhouse in the fashionable West Village, offering the best of Manhattan living with the privacy of a house. The private rooftop terrace with a hot tub and outdoor kitchen is perfect for entertaining. Interiors are finished to a high standard with bespoke joinery, heated floors, and a chef's kitchen. Direct access garage and a home office on the lower level complete this incredible package.

title: Mountain Retreat with Alpine Views
description: A beautifully designed alpine retreat with panoramic mountain views in every direction. Constructed from natural stone and reclaimed timber, this four-bedroom home blends seamlessly into its stunning natural surroundings. The great room features a double-height stone fireplace and cathedral ceilings. Ski-in/ski-out access to the Vail Resort is just 200 metres away. A genuine mountain sanctuary.

title: Desert Modern Villa
description: A striking desert-modern residence designed by celebrated Scottsdale architect Maria Chen. Clean geometric lines, drought-resistant native landscaping, and a dramatic entry courtyard set the tone. Inside, polished concrete floors, exposed steel beams, and floor-to-ceiling glass create a dialogue with the Sonoran Desert landscape. The resort-style pool and ramada are an entertainer's paradise. A rare fusion of art and architecture.
address: 4201 N Desert Bloom Way, Scottsdale, AZ 85251

title: Historic Brownstone with Garden
description: A magnificent pre-war brownstone in one of the most coveted Brooklyn Heights blocks. Spanning five levels with a full garden apartment below, this property offers extraordinary flexibility for the discerning buyer. The parlour floor features original ceiling medallions, marble fireplaces, and 11-foot ceilings. A glass and steel kitchen extension opens to a south-facing garden. Rarely does a property of this quality come to market.

title: Waterfront Commercial Premises
description: A premium commercial space in an enviable waterfront location, ideally suited to boutique retail, a flagship restaurant, or creative office use. The double-height ground floor features raw concrete ceilings, polished concrete floors, and expansive north-facing glazing. A mezzanine level adds additional flexible space. Loading dock, rear car parking for 8 vehicles, and all services connected. Available for immediate occupation.

title: Hilltop Acreage with Development Potential
description: A rare 5-acre hilltop parcel in the rapidly developing Westlake corridor, offering sweeping views of the Austin skyline and surrounding Hill Country. Zoned for single-family residential with secondary dwelling allowance. Services to the boundary. A short drive to the Barton Creek Greenbelt and 15 minutes to downtown Austin. Land of this calibre and location is increasingly scarce. Survey and soil reports available on request.
address: Lot 7, Hilltop Road, Westlake Hills, TX 78746

title: Mid-Century Modern Classic
description: A stunning mid-century modern residence authentically restored to its former glory while incorporating thoughtful contemporary updates. Designed by a student of Frank Lloyd Wright, the home's iconic butterfly roof, clerestory windows, and indoor-outdoor living zones are in impeccable condition. The chef's kitchen and bathrooms have been updated using period-appropriate materials. Set on a corner lot with mature landscaping.

title: Luxury Sky Residences – Floor 38
description: Residences at this height in the new Solaris Tower are rarely offered for private sale. This north-east corner apartment commands views from Central Park to the Hudson River. Wide-plank white oak floors, custom millwork, and Miele appliance suite are standard across all residences. The building's five-star amenities include an attended lobby, fitness centre, children's playroom, and private dining room. Pre-war building-inspired facade with modern interiors.
address: 100 Solaris Tower, Floor 38, New York, NY 10019

title: Lakefront Retreat on 2 Acres
description: A serene lakefront property on a private, spring-fed lake just 45 minutes from downtown Austin. This fully updated three-bedroom retreat sits on 2 acres of gently sloping land leading to a private dock. The main residence features an open-plan kitchen and living area with wraparound verandah and spectacular lake views. A guest cottage and boat shed complete the property. A unique opportunity for those seeking privacy and natural beauty.

title: Premium Commercial Showroom
description: A high-profile commercial showroom space in Scottsdale's prestigious design district, surrounded by luxury automotive, interior design, and fashion brands. The 3,600 sq ft ground floor space features 18-foot ceilings, polished terrazzo floors, and a dramatic all-glass frontage. A rear workshop, kitchenette, and two restrooms add to the functionality. Ample off-street parking and high pedestrian and vehicle exposure make this an exceptional commercial offering.

title: Vacant Corner Lot – Development Ready
description: A level, fully serviced corner lot of 0.75 acres in the heart of Denver's flourishing RiNo Art District. Zoned U-MX-3 allowing for residential, mixed-use, or commercial development up to 5 stories. All services connected and accessible at the boundary. Demolition of the existing structure is complete and the site is cleared and ready. The city's planning department has expressed support for a mixed residential-retail proposal. Rare inner-city land opportunity.

title: Waterfront Modern Villa
description: An extraordinary waterfront villa on a protected bay in Miami's exclusive Bay Point enclave. Designed for effortless indoor-outdoor living, the open-plan ground floor disappears behind retractable glass walls to reveal a deep covered terrace, summer kitchen, and infinity-edge pool overlooking the water. The upper level hosts four en-suite bedrooms, each with a private balcony. A 60-foot private dock accommodates large vessels. Offered fully furnished.
